purpose: Convert repository meaning into bounded, replayable, falsifiable agent execution.
prime_rule: Only meaning that changes execution is operational context.

operational_steps.name: resolve_intent
operational_steps.operation: Classify the request as documentation, schema, gate, artifact, code, benchmark, release, or claim-status change.
operational_steps.blocking_condition: The request implies promotion but does not name evidence.

operational_steps.name: load_canonical_context
operational_steps.operation: Read the smallest authority set needed for the intent.
operational_steps.blocking_condition: The required authority file is missing, stale, or contradicted.

operational_steps.name: compress_semantic_core
operational_steps.operation: Remove prose that does not constrain execution; preserve invariants, boundaries, commands, hashes, schemas, and falsifiers.
operational_steps.blocking_condition: Critical meaning depends on human memory or chat-only context.

operational_steps.name: bind_claims_to_evidence
operational_steps.operation: Attach every claim to tier, evidence pointer, falsifier, and replay path.

operational_steps.name: select_executable_path
operational_steps.operation: Choose method, config, dataset, schema, command, and artifact target.
operational_steps.blocking_condition: No deterministic command or schema exists.

operational_steps.name: verify_and_falsify
operational_steps.operation: Run or define tests, schema validation, null baseline, cost model, replay check, and falsifier path.
operational_steps.blocking_condition: Nulls are absent, schema fails, or replay is impossible.

operational_steps.name: emit_replayable_artifact
operational_steps.operation: Persist result, decision, evidence, logs, checksums, git state, and remaining blockers.
operational_steps.blocking_condition: Result exists only as prose, screenshot, memory, or terminal impression.

final_rule: No bounded context, no deterministic method, no checked artifact, no falsifiable replay — no inference.
